output.summary:
KEP-2337 proposed an api-approved.kubernetes.io annotation on CustomResourceDefinitions so the kube-apiserver can set a KubeAPIApproved condition for CRDs in k8s.io/kubernetes.io API groups, requiring a link to the approving PR. The KEP's status is recorded as implemented (stage stable), from 2021-02-09.</summary>
<parameter name="rationale">The problem is that unapproved APIs could be added to community-owned *.k8s.io and *.kubernetes.io groups by accident. The readme proposes the annotation as a guard: a URL to the approving PR sets the condition true, while a missing or "unapproved" value sets it false. The sources do not explain the reasoning behind the implemented status beyond the discussion of KEP status rules in PR #3007, which concerned process and PRR files rather than this feature's design.

alternatives.option: Prevent malicious users from claiming reserved names
alternatives.why_not: Listed as a non-goal; the annotation only guards against accidental claims, not deliberate ones.

alternatives.option: Treat an unapproved CRD in a kube group as a hard rejection in v1
alternatives.why_not: The readme says only that in v1 the annotation 'will be required' to create such a CRD; the sources do not describe a separate rejected alternative.

evidence.quote: This KEP proposes adding an `api-approved.kubernetes.io` annotation to CustomResourceDefinition. This is only needed if the CRD group is `k8s.io`, `kubernetes.io`, or ends with `.k8s.io`, `.kubernetes.io`.
If a new server sees a CRD for a resource in a kube group and does not see the annotation, it will set the `KubeAPIApproved` condition to false.
Prevent accidentally including an unapproved API in community owned API groups
This KEP was initially declared implementable at alpha, before PRR was required. The retroactive PR incorrectly called this "implemented" at beta, so it skipped PRR this cycle.
It landed after https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/2672 (which made PRR required for implementable), but since it landed as implemented, it skipped PRR
